name: Bill Huizenga
stance: Frames AI-chip export controls and protection of U.S. frontier-model weights from theft as core national-security safeguards.

statements.text: Original co-lead of the bipartisan Chip Security Act requiring location verification on advanced AI chips before export.

Introduced the Deterring American AI Model Theft Act, targeting model-extraction ('distillation') attacks that steal U.S. frontier-model weights and architectures, with sanctions and a name-and-shame list.
Model extraction attacks are the latest frontier of Chinese economic coercion and theft of US intellectual property
Called his Deterring American AI Model Theft Act a must-pass bill to stop model extraction (distillation) attacks, after the White House said Moonshot AI had distilled an Anthropic model.
America, not China must set the rules of the road on AI. @SenFettermanPA is right and Bernie Sanders is incredibly wrong.
Promoted his Chip Security Act, a bill to stop China from acquiring the advanced chips needed for its civilian and military AI capabilities.
